properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms associated with a low pressure area  located a few hundred miles east of Bermuda have become less  organized over the past several hours. Environmental conditions  appear marginally conducive for development over the next couple of  days as the system moves slowly westward and southward over the  subtropical Atlantic. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...20 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...30 percent.

Disorganized showers and thunderstorms continue with a tropical wave  located several hundred miles south of southern Mexico.  Environmental conditions remain conducive for gradual development of  this system, and a tropical depression is likely to form late this  weekend or early next week while it moves gradually northwestward  and then northward off the coast of southwestern Mexico. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

A tropical wave located well to the south-southwest of the  southern tip of the Baja California Peninsula is showing signs of  organization. Environmental conditions appear conducive for  additional development of this system, and a tropical depression is  likely to form this weekend or early next week as it moves westward  at at 10 to 15 mph across the western part of the East Pacific. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...40 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

properties.nhcTitle: Well East-Southeast of the Hawaiian Islands (Former TD15-E)
properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms continue in association with the remnants  of Tropical Depression Fifteen-E. Environmental conditions appear  only marginally conducive for some development of this system as it  moves gradually westward, remaining east-southeast of the Hawaiian  Islands.  
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...10 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.
